purpose: Determine whether a browser-based open-source crawler can reach the three official China policy entry points from the current runtime.

conclusion.finding: Crawl4AI and its Chromium runtime work, but the current runtime cannot establish a navigable connection to the three official government domains.
conclusion.implication: Changing the HTML parser or adding AI extraction cannot resolve this failure. No official document data was collected.
conclusion.disallowed_next_step: Do not enable stealth, proxy rotation or access-control evasion merely to force access.
conclusion.safe_next_step: Run the same no-login probe from a network that can normally reach the official domains, or execute a transparent scheduled collector that preserves direct official URLs and raw-response hashes.
